# Remote triggers

## Remote instance connected

Runs when another Cuebot connects to this one, or this one connects to it. Useful to know the other computer is ready.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Instance** | Which other Cuebot, by the name you gave it in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to react to any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%instanceName%` | The name of the other Cuebot |
| `%instanceLabel%` | The name you gave it in your settings |
| `%instanceId%` | Its ID |
| `%instanceOs%` | Its computer system, like Windows |
| `%instanceVersion%` | Its Cuebot version |
| `%direction%` | outgoing if this Cuebot connected to the other one, incoming if the other one connected here |

<small>Type id: `remote.connected`</small>

## Remote instance disconnected

Runs when the link to another Cuebot is lost, for example when its computer is switched off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Instance** | Which other Cuebot, by the name you gave it in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to react to any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%instanceName%` | The name of the other Cuebot |
| `%instanceLabel%` | The name you gave it in your settings |
| `%instanceId%` | Its ID |
| `%instanceOs%` | Its computer system, like Windows |
| `%instanceVersion%` | Its Cuebot version |
| `%direction%` | outgoing if this Cuebot had connected to the other one, incoming if the other one had connected here |

<small>Type id: `remote.disconnected`</small>

## Remote signal received

Runs when another Cuebot sends you a signal, which is a named message. Lets a second computer start things on this one, like a studio PC and a gaming PC.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Signal name** | Only react to a signal with this name, like "go-live". Leave empty to react to every signal. |
| **Instance** | Which other Cuebot, by the name you gave it in the Remote instances list on the Servers page. Leave empty to react to any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%signalName%` | The name of the signal |
| `%signalSender%` | The name of the action that sent it |
| `%instanceName%` | The name of the other Cuebot |
| `%instanceLabel%` | The name you gave it in your settings |
| `%instanceId%` | Its ID |

<small>Type id: `remote.signal`</small>
